HOW TO PLAY

Small words.
Big possibilities.

  1. 01

    Click a square and type. Use Across or Down below the grid to change direction. Press Submit answer to check your words and connection.

  2. 02

    Cross exactly one existing word at a matching letter.

  3. 03

    Join the two colors. Your final word crosses both chains.

1 point per letterNo extra charge per word

Each added word costs its full letter count. Shared letters count in each added word. The two starting words are free.

Example: BERRY (5) + BEIGE (5) = 10 points, even when they share a letter.

While typing, the score counts your new boxes. Submit to count the full words. Valid words have 2–15 letters.
